intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Qafa e Llogarasë (121.6 km)

story: The final stage in Albania featured a six-rider early breakaway. The peloton, led by Lidl–Trek and Bora–Hansgrohe, caught the last escapee with 35 kilometres remaining. A joint attack by Bilbao and Fortunato proved unsuccessful, and many sprinters struggled on the uphill sections. Mads Pedersen won the sprint and reclaimed the maglia rosa.
